checks: Cancellation releases pending immediately; an older success cannot clear a newer wait
A retired error is ignored; a current error is reported
Client replacement/unmount invalidates late state callbacks
Activation starts synchronously in the user gesture; synchronous failure releases pending
method: The actual RadioActionGate module is transpiled and exercised with controlled deferred promises and pending/error callbacks. No DOM renderer, browser permission prompt or microphone device is used.
integrationReview: app/game.tsx uses the controller for microphone, playback and reconnect actions. Stop, microphone-off and client cleanup invalidate retired operations. Leaving the room stops the talkie before awaiting the server.
